title: PitchBook: defense tech companies making drones, battlefield AI, and more raised $12.3B across 175 deals in 2026 so far, up from a $9.95B from 158 deals in 2025 (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: PitchBook: defense tech companies making drones, battlefield AI, and more raised $12.3B across 175 deals in 2026 so far, up from a $9.95B from 158 deals in 2025 — Funding this year has already surpassed 2025 total as soaring valuations fuel fears of a hype cycle
